PX25-05.name: The Investigator Lolo
PX25-05.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your effect, or sent to the Trash by your [Core Charge], you can add it to the Hand.

(Can't Stack) While this card is in the Removed Zone, when you're summoning/deploying any Ultimate card, or "Devotee"/"Grandwalker" family Nexus card, fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Core][Core])]
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Devotee"/ "Concluser"/ "Ultimate Queen" family Ultimate card, and a Contract Grandwalker Nexus card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.
